item.title: Illegal beauty clinic raided, 15 foreigners arrested for misuse of PLS
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Malaysian Immigration Department (JIM) arrested 15 foreigners on suspicion of abusing their Social Visit Pass (PLS) to work at an unlicensed beauty clinic around Bukit Bintang here, yesterday. Immigration Director-General Datuk Zakaria Shaaban said all of them were detained in the Op Dandan enforcement operation carried out by the Kuala Lumpur Federal Territory Immigration Department (WPKL) as a result of public complaints and intelligence. item.title: Federal, S’wak Govts Agree On RM1.8 Bln State Takeover Of Bintulu Port – Loke
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR, Feb 4 (Bernama) — The federal government and the Sarawak state government have, in principle, agreed on a value of RM1.8 billion for the state’s acquisition of Bintulu Port, the Dewan Rakyat was told today.
